test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f6b71c091a35f2e69debf16d5c03284b3fb04b65d69f2c9cb8cc0b41f3b5c3e.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **The diamond moves clockwise and points in the direction where is moves.**

** The hexagon moves clockwise but points anticlockwise.**

Next step:

 **The diamond will be at bottom left pointing towards left.**

** The hexagon will be at top right pointing towards right.**

Now we compare the given options:

Option 1) The diamond and hexagon are positioned incorrectly.

Option 2) The pattern is correct.

Option 3) The hexagon points in wrong direction.

Option 4) The diamond points in wrong direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f23b906953b11dfae3baaa2422f3d50da81cc1da5f31f9e6c2621e31629afe7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2.**
